claim: The sample ledger stays separate from the real ledger
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /demo; assert five rows, demo banner, and no real ledger key

claim: Exports every note as Markdown and JSON
sandbox: demo ledger; download both formats; assert five quotes and CFIs

claim: Book text, highlights, and notes stay on this device
sandbox: intercept the full demo flow and assert no cross-origin request

claim: Saved ledgers and core exports work offline
sandbox: load /demo once, set the browser offline, reload, and export JSON

claim: Imports KOReader Lua, Kobo CSV, and bridge JSON files
sandbox: bundled KOReader, Kobo, and bridge ledger strings; assert one parsed record from each

claim: Finds an unmatched quote inside an EPUB chapter and adds a CFI
sandbox: fresh browser context; generated one-chapter EPUB and Kobo CSV fixture

claim: Writes a new JSON sidecar without replacing an existing sidecar
sandbox: temporary folder containing an existing sidecar; write a second sidecar, assert its JSON is present, and assert the original contents remain unchanged

claim: The desktop app watches selected Calibre and reader folders for changes
where: landing price section, download page, README
sandbox: temporary Calibre metadata database and mounted-reader folder; assert Calibre scanning, create a Kobo database record, receive a watcher event, and assert the refreshed scan contains that annotation

claim: A valid one-time license activates the desktop folder tools
where: landing price section, download page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context with a recorded valid Sociobot verification response and the Tauri runtime marker; assert the unlocked desktop ledger shows Choose folders

claim: Reads documented Kobo database highlight records
sandbox: temporary mounted-reader folder with a bundled-schema KoboReader.sqlite record; assert its quote, source, and EPUB CFI

claim: The macOS and Linux installer accepts a matching AppImage and refuses a changed one
where: README install and release section, download page
sandbox: temporary command path with recorded GitHub-release responses, a matching fixture AppImage, and then a changed checksum; assert install only happens for the matching file

claim: The download page caches one release for one hour and shows a release-page fallback when GitHub is unavailable
sandbox: fresh browser context with a recorded release response; reload to assert one request, clear the cache, abort the request, and assert the fallback link

claim: Until Sociobot registers checkout, the app does not send visitors to a broken checkout URL
where: landing price section, download page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; open the landing page, assert the registration state has no checkout link, and record no checkout request
